objective: Return to Verner Osgood in Redridge.  Give him the Crate of Horseshoes.

description: Ok, I'll give him his 50 horseshoes...
Here they are, all boxed up and ready to go!  Tell Verner it was a pleasure doing business, and be sure he reads the note attached to this crate!
progress: Great, you're back! Did you get the shoes?
completion: Thank you, this really helps me out.
But what's this? Argus sent a note with the crate...What?? Argus wants me to PAY him? Bah!
Well, <name>, thank you for your help.
